candidates.description: Common German verb prefixes and nominalizing morphemes, particularly variations of "ge-" and related past participle or collective noun markers.
This feature vector activates strongly on German definite articles and personal or possessive pronouns in oblique grammatical cases.
These tokens function as German possessive determiners and pronouns inflected for various cases and genders.
German auxiliary and modal verbs indicating tense, voice, or mood.
These tokens represent common German action verbs in various conjugated forms and infinitives.
This vector represents first and third-person personal pronouns in German and English.
These tokens function as German modal particles and adverbial modifiers that nuance the certainty, scope, or polarity of a statement.
These tokens represent German masculine and neuter genitive/dative/accusative articles and determiners or their morphological fragments.
These tokens represent German modal and auxiliary verbs, as well as their inflected or truncated forms.
